headword: {入国管理局|にゅうこくかんりきょく}
reading: にゅうこくかんりきょく

definitions.explanation: The government agency responsible for immigration control, visa processing, and residence status management. In Japan, this function is now handled by the Immigration Services Agency ({出入国在留管理庁|しゅつにゅうこくざいりゅうかんりちょう}), established in 2019.

examples.japanese: {入国管理局|にゅうこくかんりきょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ビザ→ビザ：08283_biza⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I completed the visa procedures at the immigration bureau.

examples.japanese: ⟦{在留|ざいりゅう}カード→在留カード：23526_zairyuukaado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}→更新：04765_koushin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入国管理局|にゅうこくかんりきょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}か→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: I have to go to the immigration bureau to renew my residence card.

examples.japanese: {入国管理局|にゅうこくかんりきょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{混雑|こんざつ}している→混雑する：25387_konzatsusuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: The immigration bureau is crowded from the morning, so it's better to go early.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{入国|にゅうこく}→入国：15859_nyuukoku⟧ (entry into a country), ⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧ (management), and ⟦{局|きょく}→局：02687_kyoku⟧ (bureau). Often abbreviated as {入管|にゅうかん} in casual speech.

In 2019, Japan reorganized its immigration functions into the {出入国在留管理庁|しゅつにゅうこくざいりゅうかんりちょう} (Immigration Services Agency), but the older term {入国管理局|にゅうこくかんりきょく} remains widely used in everyday conversation. Foreign residents in Japan frequently visit these offices for visa extensions, status changes, and re-entry permits.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入国管理局|にゅうこくかんりきょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to the immigration bureau
- {入国管理局|にゅうこくかんりきょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to complete procedures at immigration
- {入国管理局|にゅうこくかんりきょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧: immigration bureau counter

- {出入国在留管理庁|しゅつにゅうこくざいりゅうかんりちょう}: Immigration Services Agency (current official name)
